title: Verify Administrator can reverse a Part Sales invoice
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Administrator role. (this role has Part Sales: Delete, which gates reversing a Part Sales invoice per spec v33).
At least one Part Sales invoice exists under Part Sales.
steps:
1. Click Part Sales in the main navigation.
2. Open an existing Part Sales invoice.
3. Click Reverse and confirm.
expected: The Part Sales invoice is reversed successfully with no permission error.
